current_bootshim.source: inherited from upstream Selene/Luna BootShim packaging

observed_fixed_reserved_evidence.note: Matching CP2A vendor_kernel_boot provides two base DTBs. Neither has a fixed reserved-memory reg overlapping 0x5fc41000..0x5ff00000, but /memory reg is a zero placeholder, the memreserve table is empty, and active size-only reserved-memory pools use broad alloc-ranges. This still does not prove pre-Linux firmware leaves the relocation range free.

required_next_evidence: Pre-Linux bootloader/TrustZone/firmware memory ownership (or an equivalent authoritative memory map) for 0x5fc41000..0x5ff00000.
Runtime-patched memory information from a safe read-only source when available; static base DTB /memory reg is zero.
Recovery path review before any hardware boot experiment.
